## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: Cycle ledger schema extended (cycle-ledger.md contract updated): each cycle entry now contains `findings` (array of [file, line_range, category] tuples), `commit_sha` (40-char string), and optional `reconstruction_gaps` (boolean). schema_version bumped 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 with backward-compat reader handling absent fields.
- DD3: PR comment marker format extended: `DSO-Review-Cycle: K commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>` where tuples is a JSON array of [file, line_range, category] entries. Format documented in cycle-ledger.md.

## Implementation Notes

Edit `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md` (no code, doc-only):

1. Bump top-level schema_version from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 in the contract header.
2. Cycle Object Schema section — add three new fields:
   - `findings` (array, optional in v1.1.0 for backward-compat with v1.0.0 readers; present in all v1.1.0 writes): array of [file, line_range, category] tuples. Each element is a 3-element array of strings.
   - `commit_sha` (string, 40 chars, optional in v1.1.0): HEAD commit SHA at the time the cycle was closed.
   - `reconstruction_gaps` (boolean, optional): true when CI reconstruction was incomplete.
3. Document backward-compat: readers must tolerate v1.0.0 records (no findings/commit_sha) gracefully; writers must emit v1.1.0 schema with new fields populated.
4. CI Reconstruction section — extend the PR comment Trailer Format:
   - Old: `DSO-Review-Cycle: <cycle_num> findings-hash=<hash>`
   - New (v1.1.0): `DSO-Review-Cycle: <cycle_num> commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json-array>`
   - Document parser must tolerate both formats; old format produces ledger entry without findings/commit_sha.
5. Add a Change Log entry for 2026-05-17 documenting the v1.1.0 schema bump and link to this story.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] cycle-ledger.md contains schema_version 1.1.0
  Verify: grep -q "schema_version.*1\.1\.0" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
- [ ] cycle-ledger.md documents findings tuples field
  Verify: grep -E "findings.*tuple|findings.*\[file.*line_range.*category\]" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
- [ ] cycle-ledger.md documents commit_sha field
  Verify: grep -q "commit_sha" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
- [ ] Extended PR comment marker format documented
  Verify: grep -E "tuples=" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
- [ ] Backward-compat note present (readers tolerate v1.0.0)
  Verify: grep -iE "backward.compat|v1\.0\.0" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md

## DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION
Gate fired: 2 (existing reference doc — cycle-ledger.md contract)
Target file: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no — N/A

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
